unsupported: Kyana serves manufacturers, e-commerce fulfillment centers, warehouses, and logistics operations that need reliable packaging materials and value-added services.
Its logistics division handles warehousing and distribution for clients across the Midwest, while the die-cutting unit supports custom protective packaging for fragile or irregularly shaped goods.
The business was founded on the idea that a supplier could do more than drop off boxes — it could help customers solve packaging challenges, reduce waste, and lower total cost.
That service-first mindset still drives the company’s expansion into logistics, kitting, and custom fabrication.
